# Rosebud Cloud Solutions

> Enterprise Azure architecture, cloud security, DevSecOps, and managed cloud services. Microsoft-certified consultancy delivering secure, scalable infrastructure for regulated industries.

Rosebud Cloud Solutions (RCS) is a UK-based Microsoft-certified consultancy specialising in Azure platform architecture, cloud security, compliance, DevSecOps, and managed cloud operations. Clients include Tier-1 financial institutions, public sector organisations, legal firms, and retail businesses. Registered in England and Wales, company number 14500087, based in Worthing, West Sussex.

## Tools

- [Free Domain Security Check](https://www.rosebudcloudsolutions.co.uk/security-check): Free external security scanner for any domain. Checks email authentication records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), TLS certificates, HTTP security headers, and attacker-visible subdomains. No registration or installation, results in around 15 seconds. Built by RCS to help UK organisations spot email spoofing exposure and web security gaps at no cost.

## Services

- [Azure Landing Zones](https://www.rosebudcloudsolutions.co.uk/services/azure-landing-zones): Structured landing zones with management groups, policy frameworks, and Infrastructure-as-Code deployment.
- [Cloud Security & Compliance](https://www.rosebudcloudsolutions.co.uk/services/cloud-security): Zero-trust architectures, Microsoft Defender, and continuous compliance monitoring aligned to recognised standards.
- [DevSecOps](https://www.rosebudcloudsolutions.co.uk/services/devsecops): Security embedded in delivery pipelines, with automated policy enforcement, secret management, and vulnerability scanning for Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.
- [Cloud Optimisation](https://www.rosebudcloudsolutions.co.uk/services/cloud-optimisation): Azure cost reduction through architectural review, FinOps discipline, and automated optimisation.
- [Advisory & Consulting](https://www.rosebudcloudsolutions.co.uk/services/advisory-consulting): Strategic Azure advisory for cloud adoption, platform architecture, and modernisation.
- [Managed Cloud](https://www.rosebudcloudsolutions.co.uk/services/managed-cloud): Ongoing management, monitoring, and improvement of Azure platforms with enterprise-grade SLAs.

## Research

- [UK Housing Email Security Report 2026](https://www.rosebudcloudsolutions.co.uk/reports/uk-housing-email-security-2026): Original research by RCS. A passive external scan of 200 English housing associations (every private registered provider owning 1,000+ homes, ~2.76 million homes). Key findings: 2 in 5 have no enforced DMARC and can be spoofed, 31% published DMARC but left it at p=none (monitoring only), mean security score 79/100. Aggregate, methodology-transparent, scanned 12 June 2026.

## Guides

- [SPF, DKIM and DMARC explained in plain English](https://www.rosebudcloudsolutions.co.uk/insights/spf-dkim-dmarc-explained): What the three email authentication standards do, how they work together to stop spoofing, and the five misconfigurations seen most often in UK businesses. By Alex Hunte, Founder and Lead Architect.
- [How to set up DMARC for Microsoft 365 without breaking your email](https://www.rosebudcloudsolutions.co.uk/insights/set-up-dmarc-microsoft-365): Step-by-step DMARC rollout for Microsoft 365: verify SPF and DKIM, monitor at p=none, fix senders, then tighten to reject safely. By Alex Hunte.
